primitives.name: Proximity-Aware Contextual Transformer
primitives.verbatim_quote: **Verdict:** ADAPT — the proximity-aware contextual transformer (FT-Transformer + structured feature-relationship embeddings) is a concrete architecture upgrade for GSE's tabular models, and its feature-engineering idea (neighboring-round context windows) ports directly to play/drive-level NFL features; the Dream11 spending numbers themselves do not transfer.

reasoning_traces.think:
The core innovation lies in encoding temporal and contextual feature dependencies through explicit proximity-aware windows, which enables efficient modeling of user behavior in gaming rounds. The model's architecture extends FT-Transformer by incorporating structured embeddings that capture statistical and temporal correlations. In GSI, this translates to improved calibration of spending propensity predictions using conformal inference techniques. For GSE, it maps to enhanced situational awareness in NFL play-by-play analysis, where rolling window features provide contextual cues for decision-making. The failure mode occurs when temporal dependencies are too complex or when the fixed window size underfits or overfits the data. Dualities emerge in how attention weights shift between static and dynamic features, and how the model balances expressivity against computational cost.
